senses.definition: (transitive) To move an object over, maintaining contact, with the intention of removing some substance from the surface. (Compare rub.)
examples: Melissa wiped her glasses with her shirt.
I wiped the sweat from my brow with the back of my hand.
Tom started to wipe his eyes.

quotes.text: So they passed through the Palace Gates and were led into a big room with a green carpet and lovely green furniture set with emeralds. The soldier made them all wipe their feet upon a green mat before entering this room, and when they were seated he said politely[…]

senses.definition: (transitive) To smear (a substance) with this kind of motion.
examples: You've wiped grease all over your shirt.

senses.definition: (transitive) To remove by rubbing; to rub off; to obliterate; usually followed by away, off, or out.

quotes.text: Some natural tears they dropped, but wiped them soon.

senses.definition: (ambitransitive) To clean (the anus, buttocks and/or genitals) after defecation or urination.
examples: I had nothing to wipe my bum with.
Even if you wipe very carefully, you still have to wash your hands afterward.

senses.definition: (transitive, computing) To erase.
examples: I accidentally wiped my hard drive.

senses.definition: (transitive, plumbing) To make (a joint, as between pieces of lead pipe), by surrounding the junction with a mass of solder, applied in a plastic condition by means of a rag with which the solder is shaped by rubbing.
(figurative) To remove an expression from one's face.
examples: You should wipe that smirk off your face before the boss comes in.

quotes.text: Please wipe that look out of your eyes, it's bribing me to doubt myself.

senses.definition: (transitive) To deperm (a ship).
(media) To perform a transition in which one scene or slide is replaced with another over time along a horizontal axis, as if one scene or slide is a layer being slid off the other.

quotes.text: Steve-O tells the camera, “Don’t worry; the next skit’s gonna be amazing”; he then pretends to grab the side of the screen, which “wipes” to the next shot.

senses.definition: (UK, slang, obsolete) To hit or strike.
(obsolete) To cheat; to defraud; to trick; usually followed by out.
